zh: 吃完晚饭我们结清了账就回家了。
en: After dinner we {settled up|paid up|paid} and went home.

zh: 我们大概每周在外面吃一次。
en: We {eat out|dine out|go out} about once a week.

zh: 是在这儿吃还是带走？
en: Is that to have here or {take away|takeaway|take out|to take away|to go}?

zh: 咖啡馆十点前就把燕麦奶用完了。
en: The café {ran out of|was out of|sold out of} oat milk by ten o'clock.

zh: 我回家路上顺便去取披萨。
en: I'll {pick up|grab|collect|get} the pizza on my way home.

zh: 我们在那家泰国餐馆订了七点的位子。
en: We're {booked in|booked} for seven at the Thai place.

zh: 订了位，结果有一半的人没来。
en: Half the group didn't {turn up|show up|come|show|arrive} for the booking.

zh: 这顿饭每个人凑了二十块钱。
en: Everyone {chipped in|put in|paid|gave|contributed} twenty dollars for the meal.

zh: 主菜上来之前别吃面包吃饱了。
en: Don't {fill up on} bread before the mains arrive.

zh: 你能帮我把这个派热一下吗？
en: Could you {heat up|warm up|heat|warm|reheat|microwave} this pie for me?

zh: 服务员一直在给我们的水杯加水。
en: The waiter keeps {topping up|filling up|refilling|filling} our water glasses.

zh: 孩子们两分钟就把整份甜点吃了个精光。
en: The kids {polished off|finished off|finished|ate|demolished|wolfed down} the whole dessert in two minutes.

zh: 菜要凉了，大家快开吃吧！
en: The food's getting cold, so {tuck in|dig in|eat up|start|eat}, everyone!

zh: 今晚叫外卖吧，我不想做饭。
en: Let's {order in|get takeaways|get takeaway|order takeaways|order takeaway} tonight. I don't feel like cooking.

zh: 我想我就点羊肉吧。
en: I think I'll {go for|have|get|order|try|choose|take} the lamb.

zh: 这个汉堡配薯条吗？
en: Does the burger {come with|include|have} chips?

zh: 我们在靠窗的一张桌子旁坐了下来。
en: We {sat down|sat} at a table by the window.

zh: 我们还没吃完，服务员就把盘子收走了。
en: The waiter {cleared away|took away|cleared|removed|took|collected} our plates before we'd finished.

zh: 上班前我们顺路进去喝了杯咖啡。
en: We {popped in|stopped in|dropped in|called in|stopped|stopped off} for a quick coffee before work.

zh: 九点钟那家早午餐店外面就有人在排队了。
en: People were {queuing up|queueing up|lining up|queuing|queueing|waiting} outside the brunch place by nine.
